answer: Smolder-bond identity: voters post a 100-token bond burning 2 tokens per epoch while voting. At settlement, seven rotating witnesses check each ballot floor; under 100 suspends and forfeits the rest. The anchor is arithmetic: n clones pay 100n plus 2n per epoch, and burned tokens rest on a public ledge nobody reclaims; recycled wallets restart each clone at zero. The fee clock runs only on live identities, so nothing is pre-farmable: savings cannot be crystallized in advance, and stored credit never beats the burn. Anyone audits the ledger and confirms each full-floor vote.
